document: National Identification Number (NIN) and its slip
office: the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC), at its offices and licensed enrolment partners

routes.label: enrolment at a NIMC office or licensed partner
premium enrolment at a licensed lounge, visa centre or by appointment

note: NIMC's fees as reviewed in 2025, as Ripples Nigeria reported them: the first enrolment and NIN slip are free, premium (VIP) enrolment N20,000; a reissued slip N600, a date-of-birth correction N28,574 and other changes N2,000 (not modelled); abroad, the enrolment in African countries is USD 50 for an adult and 30 for a child (not modelled). Nigeria's identity document in practice is the NIN and its slip; the general multipurpose card's fee isn't stated. NIMC's own pages load only through a script that failed this session. The time and term aren't stated.

sources.title: Ripples Nigeria, Nigerian govt introduces new fee structure for NIN
sources.said: Under the revised structure, the cost of re-issuing a NIN slip has increased from N500 to N600. However, initial enrollment and issuance of the first NIN slip remain free. ... For those seeking VIP or premium enrollment services, typically offered in licensed lounges, visa application centers, or via pre-booked appointments, the fee now stands at N20,000.

sources.title: Nairametrics, NIN: How illegal charges slow down Nigeria's identity project (10 December 2024)
sources.said: But the NIMC is insisting that any charge for NIN enrolment across Nigeria is illegal as it is 100% free.
